title: The Quiet Gravity
author: Sebastian Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Nystrom, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
